note: Candidates and their official access routes. Not data, and not an integration state.

sources.license: NASA open data; POWER citation requested
sources.processing: Same tiling and cell alignment as the retained T2M/PRECTOTCORR climatology; fill value −999 kept as missing.
sources.provider: NASA Langley Research Center, POWER project
sources.purpose: Climatological near-surface wind speed (2 m, 10 m, 50 m) and humidity/pressure on ASTERRO's own grid, for wind exposure and aeolian-process context.

routes.note: the route used for the retained POWER climatology (API v2.10.0)
parameter dictionary, to confirm WS2M, WS10M, WS50M, RH2M, PS

sources.validation: Grid identity with power_climatology.npz; physical ranges; spot comparison with REMS/MEDA is not a validation (different planet).
sources.value: Unlocks wind exposure (atmosphere, dust/aeolian, EVA/habitat operations). Reanalysis, not observation: labelled as such.

sources.processing: Decode rendered colours with the layer's colormap (as for LST), aggregate to cells, keep retrieval counts.
sources.provider: NASA ESDIS, Global Imagery Browse Services
sources.purpose: Column aerosol optical depth climatology as an atmospheric dust/aerosol indicator (never as surface dust deposition).

routes.note: the route used for the retained MODIS LST
to find the exact AOD layer and its colormap

sources.spatial: rendered imagery; native product resolution per layer
sources.validation: Quantisation error from the colormap; comparison with MCD19A2 or MERRA-2 AOD if those become accessible.
sources.value: First aerosol indicator. Decoded from imagery: labelled 'satellite-derived, decoded', proxy for dust.

sources.processing: Monthly climatology over 2001–2020 to match POWER.
sources.purpose: Dust column mass and dust AOD (reanalysis) to separate dust from other aerosols.
sources.validation: AERONET comparisons published by GMAO (reference only).
sources.value: Dust-specific aerosol; model output, labelled as such.

sources.compute: ≈ 77 000 requests: needs polite rate limiting and caching
sources.coverage: global at small scale, denser where large-scale maps exist
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (Macrostrat); source maps cited per unit
sources.processing: Query each land cell centre (or a sample of points per cell); keep source map id and scale; never treat as a field survey.
sources.purpose: Geological map units at a point: lithology, age range, map scale and source map, for cell-level geological context.
sources.storage: ≈ 20–60 MB JSON for all land cells
sources.validation: Spot checks against well-known units (e.g. Deccan basalts, Atacama evaporites); share of cells with a unit.
sources.value: Unlocks geology, surface materials and part of resources; volcanic, sedimentary and evaporite context.

sources.dataset_id: Volcanoes of the World (VOTW) Holocene list
sources.license: Smithsonian terms of use; cite VOTW version
sources.processing: Points to cells; distances for Local Impact.
sources.purpose: Inventory of Holocene volcanoes (location, type, rock type, last eruption) for volcanic context and lava-tube connections.
sources.validation: Record count against the published VOTW version; spot checks.
sources.value: Real nearby volcanoes in Local Impact; volcanic environments.

sources.processing: Aggregate the 0–5 cm layer to cells from the COGs (preferred over 77 000 point calls).
sources.purpose: Soil texture, organic carbon and pH as surface-material context.
sources.storage: ≈ 1–5 GB per property for the full global layer, or windowed reads
sources.value: Surface materials; model output, labelled as such.

sources.processing: Per-cell share of pixels with occurrence > 0, mean occurrence, and 'lost water' (transitions layer).
sources.purpose: Surface-water occurrence 1984–2021 (historical vs present water) for water-history context.
sources.storage: occurrence layer ≈ 6–10 GB if all tiles are read; windowed/streamed reading preferred
sources.validation: Published accuracy (omission/commission); compare with Natural Earth lakes.

sources.processing: Class shares per cell from overviews (COG pyramids) instead of full resolution.
sources.purpose: Land cover classes (bare/sparse, snow/ice, water, vegetation) per cell.
sources.storage: ≈ 100 GB at full resolution; overviews keep it to a few GB

sources.purpose: Higher-resolution terrain for aspect and landform scale.
sources.validation: Compare with GMTED2010 cell means (already integrated).
Area totals against the RGI documentation.

sources.license: per record: CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC; recorded per record
sources.processing: Fixed, documented taxon list; keep dataset key, licence, basis of record, date, uncertainty; drop records without coordinates.
sources.purpose: Documented occurrence records of selected extremophile taxa (halophiles, acidophiles, psychrophiles) with source, date and coordinate uncertainty.
sources.validation: Taxon-key resolution via the GBIF species API; counts per taxon; sampling-bias note.
sources.value: Biological evidence: presence records, never inferred life or habitability.

sources.dataset_id: Wikidata SPARQL (instances of cave / lava tube)
sources.processing: Keep item id, label, class, coordinates, stated length/depth with their references.
sources.purpose: Documented caves and lava tubes with coordinates as a community-maintained inventory (not authoritative, not complete).
sources.validation: Spot checks of known lava tubes; share of items with references.
sources.value: Subsurface context in Local Impact, labelled as an incomplete inventory.

sources.dataset_id: Geologic Map of Mars, SIM 3292 (Tanaka et al. 2014), 1:20M
sources.instrument: MOLA, THEMIS, CTX, HRSC based mapping
sources.purpose: Global geologic units of Mars for the planetary side of a geological comparison (map classes, not mineralogy).
sources.validation: Unit of Jezero/Gale against the map text.

sources.dataset_id: Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, 1:5M (Fortezzo et al. 2020)
sources.purpose: Global geologic units of the Moon for lunar targets.
sources.validation: Unit at the South Pole targets against the map text.

sources.dataset_id: MRO Mars Climate Sounder derived data
sources.processing: Seasonal column dust opacity near targets.
sources.purpose: Mars atmospheric temperature and dust profiles for the Mars side of atmospheric comparisons.

sources.processing: Summary parameters over target footprints; spectral association only.
sources.purpose: Spectral summary parameters (e.g. olivine, clay, carbonate indices) at Mars targets.
sources.value: Mars mineralogical indicators; associations, never identifications.
